paragraphs.text:
One of you quickly slips out of his bonds and frees the other. 
You are just able to retrace your path before the failing light 
makes backtracking impossible.

You find the bound form of Sylvia. Norman cuts her bonds 
and she falls into your arms, trembling. She is quiet for a few 
minutes before she draws herself up, and you can almost see 
her summon the determination that built her family’s fortunes.

Once she is ready to walk, you hurry your group away. There 
might  be  some  anthropological  value  in  studying  a  place  of 
sacrifice, but this is not the time for it. You take a brief rest 
before dawn.

To  continue  exploring  the  region,  go  to  600. To  retreat  toward 
civilization, go to 513.
